title: Cross-channel release notes orchestration and in-product upgrade prompts (Migration Concierge MVP)
creator: Aisha R. Patel
description: Problem statement: When we announce model or API surface changes we currently rely on a mix of static release notes, mailing lists, and ad-hoc SDK warnings. Customers miss critical upgrade steps, integration code breaks unexpectedly, and CS spends disproportionate time triaging. Goal: deliver a coordinated cross-team pipeline that produces targeted release notes by customer segment, surfaces in-product upgrade prompts and SDK deprecation warnings, and provides a repeatable cadence for migration assistance. This ticket scopes the MVP (Migration Concierge) delivering: 1) a release notes orchestration template and workflow that produces per-audience diffs (API, SDKs, Private customers, Dedicated) 2) in-console upgrade banners with contextual next steps and links to migration guides 3) SDK runtime deprecation warnings (warn on use of removed params and call shapes) 4) a lightweight compatibility-checker CLI that customers / SEs can run to detect common incompatibilities 5) an automated changelog artifact (structured JSON) that downstream channels (email, docs, console, SDK) can consume. Out of scope for MVP: full automated client-side code mods, billing migrations, and dedicated on-prem installers. Metrics to measure success: reduction in inbound support tickets about the change by 40% in first 30 days, 70% of active customers see the console banner within 7 days of launch, compatibility-checker run by at least 20 pilot customers during runway.
acceptance_criteria: Structured release JSON is produced for a release and can be consumed by console and SDKs
Console shows rollout banners targeted by account tier and region; clickthrough goes to a migration guide
SDKs (Python/Node) emit soft deprecation warnings at runtime when deprecated parameters are used
Compatibility-checker CLI runs against a small sample of customer requests and reports compatibility score
Operational playbook published: escalation paths, rollback instructions, and post-mortem template
tasks: Define templated release JSON schema and fields (owner: PM)
ENG: implement release JSON endpoint in release tooling (ENG-22457)
DES: design console banner variants and migration guide layout (DES-4120)

Coordinate GTM: Email cadence, blog post draft, in-console prompts, support playbook
Pilot with 20 pilot customers, collect feedback, iterate
